checks: Verify Regular, Bold, Italic and Bold Italic terminal font faces.
base.limitations: No shell, prompt, global language, bootloader or package-signature changes. Niri preparation additively enables en_US.UTF-8 and runs locale-gen. Package removal is manual.

checks: Test GDM offline, keyring PAM integration without changing PAM, and polkit authentication in both sessions.
Test file chooser, screen sharing and GNOME Software Flatpak integration in both sessions.
desktop-common.limitations: User audio units are enabled globally in the user manager, never run as root services. GDM is enabled but not started. No theme or personal dotfiles are installed.

checks: Test a complete GNOME login; inspect its application grid, portals and failed user units.
gnome-minimal.limitations: No gnome/gnome-extra group, browser, extensions or application collection is requested. Existing applications are not removed or hidden.

checks: Verify packaged niri.desktop launches niri-session; test Ghostty, Fuzzel, polkit and keyring.
Test five-minute lock, ten-minute monitor blank, before-suspend lock and resume with no unlocked frame.
niri.limitations: User Niri configuration replaces the fallback entirely, including locking/startup. polkit-gnome explicitly supplies the selected agent; unexpected launchers are reported, not hidden.

checks: Test physical camera, microphone, tablet, phone and Wi-Fi/Bluetooth firmware.
hardware.limitations: Detection is advisory, not hardware certification. Review selected firmware and Intel VA-API generation. NVIDIA, DKMS, OpenCL, gaming/udev rules and multilib need separate reviewed provisioning. No forced modules or driver switches.

checks: Test Wi-Fi, OpenVPN import and the selected firewall without provisioning credentials.
network.limitations: Conflicting firewall/network services block application. No live network replacement, VPN credentials, global dnsmasq or wait-online changes. Bluetooth is hardware-detected or explicitly selected.

checks: Test GNOME power-profile switching and the chosen power daemon.
power-memory.limitations: Existing zram definitions or competing power managers require review. No live swap changes, disk writeback, hibernation or boot configuration changes.

checks: Test offline login and later retry; confirm no apps or system remote were installed.
flatpak-user.limitations: The graphical-session timer runs only in user managers, not during installation. Existing remotes/apps are preserved; --if-not-exists does not replace a user's remote.

checks: Verify non-overlapping /etc/subuid and /etc/subgid mappings and rootless networking for the intended account.
containers.limitations: Missing subordinate-ID mappings receive a reviewed free 65536-ID range for the invoking regular user. Existing valid mappings are preserved; malformed, overlapping or undersized mappings stop installation. No containers, images, volumes or daemon enablement. Existing data is never removed.

checks: After a fresh local login, verify the selected user's libvirt membership and passwordless management; other users still require admin authentication.
Test /dev/kvm, UEFI, TPM and guest DHCP/DNS/HTTPS through the enabled firewall.
Verify directory storage, firmware/TPM state and separate qemu:///session inventory.
virtualization-core.limitations: The invoking regular user joins libvirt and receives local-active-session passwordless management (root-equivalent). Existing monolithic daemons, other authorization rules or other libvirt members require review. A next-boot oneshot prepares/autostarts default NAT without overwriting network XML or disabling the firewall. No guests/images/pools are created; guest autostart remains deliberate.

checks: Test local SPICE/OpenGL, virtio GL/QXL, render-node access, PipeWire audio and USB redirection.
virtualization-3d.limitations: Backend names/content are verified on target; no qemu-full, all-architecture emulators, remote storage backends or permissive device rules.

checks: Verify ARM32/AArch64 firmware contents and boot a deliberately supplied TCG guest.
virtualization-arm.limitations: ARM guests use TCG on x86_64; no guests or disks are downloaded/created.

checks: Verify /proc/sys/fs/binfmt_misc registers only the reviewed ARM/AArch64 emulators after deliberate reboot; test a user-supplied ARM image.
containers-arm.limitations: Only explicit ARM magic entries are managed. Any package-supplied additional registrations block application; no live binfmt restart or image download.

checks: Authenticate with tailscale up only when deliberately requested.
tailscale.limitations: No authentication, credentials or tailnet configuration.

checks: Test the physical key separately without locking out a recovery account.
security-keys.limitations: No PAM changes, enrollment or keys.

checks: Test external backup restoration, rescue boot, a fallback kernel and initramfs regeneration for the actual boot tooling.
Test failed-upgrade recovery and Secure Boot separately. Record kernel, package versions, hardware and results.
recovery.limitations: Application requires an external recovery record, not an assumed snapshot. No automatic snapshots, boot changes, rollback, package removal or reboot.
